The two-dimensional centered quadratic semigroup gives the stated e^(-alpha t) same/cross formulas for all t>=0. Strict monotonicity and alpha<beta vs alpha>=beta limits follow from increasing H(t), and the variance of the coordinate average gives the exact d formula. Independently solved the triangular moments exactly for (alpha,beta)=(1,2),(2,1),(3,3). Two-sided renewal ages and future reset coupling justify existence/uniqueness, with finite fourth moments. Only the *ratio* has critical algebraic tail, not the absolute covariance.

Earlier common-clock analogue underscores rather than eliminates usefulness of the independent-clock comparison.
